text: {"lessons":["I have repeatedly sold B and E for gains, only to buy them back later at higher prices; I should not let the pleasure of realizing a gain drive my exits.","My average cost is not a useful signal of what a stock will do next; I should focus on its prospective risk and return rather than avoiding a loss or locking in a gain.","I should assess trades in the context of my whole portfolio, including cash and diversification, instead of treating each stock as a separate account."]}
